description: AuthManager.fetchOrganizationUUID — GET /api/oauth/profile with Bearer + anthropic-beta header. Remove proxy:false so call goes through HTTPS_PROXY (claude-share MITM) → org UUID fetched with sharer token.
semantic: find-generic-password or GET call to /api/oauth/profile inside fetchOrganizationUUID method of AuthManager class

description: AuthManager.doRefreshOAuthToken — POST grant_type:refresh_token to TOKEN_URL (platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token). Remove proxy:false so refresh also goes through MITM. Receiver never triggers this (expiresAt=year 2100) but sharer-side refresh is unaffected since sharer doesn't use HTTPS_PROXY.
semantic: axios.post call with body containing grant_type:refresh_token and client_id, inside doRefreshOAuthToken
